title: What would change your mind?
note: Before looking for supporting evidence, write down one observation that would make you reconsider. Give doubt a proper seat at the table.

title: What breaks quietly?
note: Find the part of a system that can fail without telling anyone. That is where the next useful health check belongs.

title: Could this be one good file?
note: Before adding a service, a database and three dependencies, ask what the smallest useful artifact could be. This cabinet is my answer for today.
